ticket.title: verify stamps a receipt with the invoking repo's branch and commit count, even when the ticket has nothing to do with it
ticket.description:
TWO MORE MEASURED INSTANCES 2026-11-10, both while closing delivered tickets, and both are the same shape from opposite directions. (1) BW-33 was fixed in common (20213d6) but filed in benchwork store, so storypole verify BW-33 ran the benchwork chain: the receipt now attests that benchwork builds, lints and tests, and says nothing about the emission guard the ticket is about. (2) GB-347 spans twelve stores, and its verify receipt says repo storypole, chain storypole, because its crate scope storypole-core resolves to that repository (SP-50) - so the ticket wide evidence had to be recorded in prose beside the receipt rather than inside it. Nothing here is false: each receipt names the repository and chain that ran. The defect is that a reader who takes receipt exit 0 as proof of the ticket claim over-reads it, and the fix is for a receipt to say what it did not cover - the chain it ran versus the repositories the ticket touches. That is a superset of this ticket original scope, which was only about a receipt borrowing the invoking repository branch and commit count.

DELIVERED AND VERIFIED 2026-11-10 (storypole b094660, b9b0775, 8964d77, b803671). Three symptoms, one silence: a receipt named the chain it ran and said nothing about what it did not cover. BW-33 was fixed in common and certified against benchwork; SP-38 shipped a 253-line file benchwork own audit would have caught, because the ticket lives in storypole and verify ran storypole chain; GB-347 spans twelve stores and its receipt says storypole. Changes: (1) verification refuses to certify a ticket scoped to a declared member that is not checked out - resolve_target_dir used to fall back to the store root while the receipt stamped the declared repository, a record naming a tree nothing ran against, probed by verify_coverage_tests; (2) revision::coverage_line states chain, repository, window, commit count, diff hash and the declared scope in one sentence, printed by storypole show beside the unmerged and orphaned warnings, proven live: coverage: chain storypole in storypole, window d49142b23..469e86364 (2 commit(s)), diff ad89910b21a6442cec2cc7094d1f53b6c81737e1; ticket scope says storypole (storypole-core). TWO OF MY OWN DEFECTS WERE CAUGHT BY THAT LIVE PROOF AND FIXED RATHER THAN SHIPPED: the coverage line was first nested inside the unmerged-warning branch so it printed only when that warning fired, and the orphaned-window check claimed SP-41 window had been rewritten while both commits sat on main - it pointed git one directory too deep and read cannot-answer as has-gone, which window_exists now refuses (None when the directory is not a repository, the same rule is_reachable_from_main follows). Honest limit: the reader-path fixes are committed and unit-tested but the installed binary at verify time predates them, so `storypole show` will not print the corrected orphan behaviour until the next install. The refusal and the coverage line are the parts the receipt below attests.

verification_receipt.command: cargo fmt --all -- --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo nextest run --workspace && miter audit --path . --threshold 250 --paths && chalkline docs check -d .
